insert into consent_events (call_id, phone_hash, phone_last4, kind, script_ver, channel)
select $1, $2, $3, k, $4, 'voice' from unnest($5::text[]) as k
returning id

nodes.name: Retell: send confirmation SMS
nodes.notes: POST /create-sms-chat starts an SMS chat from the location's Retell number; the SMS agent (RETELL_SMS_AGENT_ID) generates the confirmation text from the dynamic variables. Retell has no plain single-message SMS endpoint.
